jobs.description: About Us: Hyundai Capital Canada (HCCA) is the Canadian captive finance business for Hyundai Motor Group. We go to market under the service brands Hyundai Motor Finance, Kia Finance and Genesis Finance. Through a network of over 450 Hyundai and Kia dealerships and 30 Genesis distributors nationwide, we provide indirect vehicle financing and leasing solutions to consumers and commercial customers. We’re a company driven by growth, innovation, and people. At HCCA, you’ll find opportunities to build new skills, expand your career, and make a real impact—while working in a diverse, inclusive, and values driven environment. Our employees contribute every day to a culture that is fast-paced, dynamic, energized, agile, and collaborative. From our employee programs to the unique design of our offices, we strive to create a connected, fun, positive, and rewarding workplace where employees feel appreciated, proud of their company, and deeply invested in HCCA’s success. Position Details: Reporting to the Manager, Treasury Operations, this role is an integral point of contact for daily Cash Management and Treasury Operations activities for Hyundai Capital Canada. Responsible for managing bank reconciliations, cash position/compliance reporting, and customer cash activity aggregation/data provision, and participating in short term liquidity forecasting and bank account maintenance activities for the HCCA Treasury team. The individual will play a significant role managing HCCA’s short-term funding facilities and will participate in the monthly sales and reporting processes covering HCCA’s securitization activities. Responsibilities: • Prepare reports of the daily cash position of HCCA and provide daily oversight of cash flow. Prepare daily bank reconciliations between the general ledger and bank balances. Work closely with the HCCA Servicing team to provide up to date customer account information in terms of customer payments, refunds and returns. Ensure all incoming and outgoing payments are processed accurately through detailed account-level reconciliations. • Assist in Cash Management process improvement initiatives involving customer refunds, credit card payments, dealer funding, dealer/OEM incentive payments and other similar projects. • Participate in compliance support activities including external audits, business continuity planning as well as assistance with development and maintenance of policies and procedures. • Coordinate and support bank account structure optimization. Maintain and verify monthly bank charges and identify cost reduction initiatives • Participate in management of short-term revolving funding facilities and securitization facility sale analyses and servicer reporting, and required financial reporting of existing transactions, in an accurate and timely manner. • Perform all other duties as assigned. jobs.description: Since 2015 Mejuri has reimagined what fine jewelry can be in a modern worldshifting it from a traditional gift to to a personal choice rooted in self-expression. Founded by third-generation jeweller Noura Sakkijha the brand was built on a simple idea: fine jewelry shouldnt require a special occasion and it should never come with guilt. Its about celebrating yourselfyour style your life your everyday. Mejuri meets customers where they areonline in app and through a growing global retail footprint of 58 stores worldwide. Mejuri is also deeply committed to doing things the right way with responsible sourcing sustainable practices and philanthropic initiatives that reflect our values and long-term vision. The role also owns the paid social testing roadmap including early tests on emerging platforms like YouTube and Reddit. Youll build launch and optimize campaigns yourself and manage day-to-day spend within the allocations your manager sets. Youll report to the Manager Growth Marketing and present results to the VP of Growth. Your closest partner is the Creative team and youll also work with Brand Organic Social Influencer Marketing E-commerce and Merchandising and Data and Analytics as well as platform reps at Meta TikTok and Pinterest. You propose and run the tests that answer that question. • Recommendations: What you learn turns into decisions. You bring data-backed proposals such as scaling an audience or adopting a new format. jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: We’re a fast-growing B2B SaaS company looking for a hands-on Marketing Specialist to execute campaigns that fuel our revenue growth, and customer retention. This role combines demand generation, digital marketing, content creation, and customer campaigns - all with measurable impact on sales and adoption. This is a hands-on role. You will build, launch, and execute campaigns, not just plan them. This role is not strategic ownership of the entire marketing function. It’s focused on quality execution and real impact. We are committed to your career growth - as the company scales, this role can grow into a Senior Specialist or Marketing Manager track depending on performance and leadership capability, as well as the possibility of moves into other teams. If you have SaaS marketing experience and thrive at running multi-channel programs that drive results, we’d love to hear from you. What You’ll Do • Run campaigns across email, paid media, social media, content, webinars, and events. • Build and schedule email campaigns • Manage the lead funnel end-to-end: campaign execution, reporting, conversion optimization, and assist with Sales. • Optimize our digital presence including website updates, landing pages, and SEO to increase inbound leads. • Create and repurpose content including customer stories (case studies, testimonials, reviews), blog posts, and sales collateral. • Assist in development sales enablement materials when needed (slide decks, brochures, RFP’s, etc) • Partner with Product & Customer Success teams on launches, adoption campaigns, upsell campaigns • Manage and update CRM and marketing automation tools. • Plan events (webinars, tradeshows, customer events), including pre- and post-event campaigns. • Manage our digital assets and oversee creation of additional materials • Work with vendors to support campaign, creative, and event needs. What We’re Looking For • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS or technology marketing (required) • Proven track record in marketing campaign execution and content. • Experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems • Familiar with SEO, paid media and digital marketing channels • Excellent written and verbal communication skills • Ability to manage multiple campaigns in a fast-paced, scaling software environment. • Highly organized and detail-oriented • Experience in a subscription-based SaaS company is strongly preferred • Ability to travel 1-3 times per year strongly preferred What We Offer We provide a company-paid competitive health and dental benefits package, paid time off, flexible work arrangements including remote, training opportunities, and more. We pride ourselves on always looking into innovative technologies and practices, and empower every member of our team to push for better solutions. We believe in open and transparent communication, being agile, and always thinking of the customer. Being open to feedback is a core value, and continually looking for ways to improve how things are done. Our team also enjoys: Remote Work • Competitive salary and paid time off • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plan • Life and disability and critical illness insurance • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) • Healthy work-life balance • Friendly and supportive culture built on performance and merit • Team and social events Accessibility and Inclusion As part of our commitment to inclusivity, diversity, equity and accessibility, our goal is a workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome all qualified applicants to apply. We are proud to be in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), 2005 and the Integrated Accessibility Standards Regulation. We are happy to honour accommodations at any part of the recruitment process and invite you to let us know how to help. Job ID: 2026-10
